steps.name: Capture evidence start
steps.definition:
- name: Capture evidence start
        run: |
          echo "CI_STARTED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          {
            echo 'CI_COMMANDS<<EOF'
            echo 'echo "CI_STARTED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"'
            echo "./mvnw '-P!openliberty' -DskipTests clean compile"
            echo "./scripts/ci/run-dependency-security-gate.sh"
            echo "./mvnw '-P!openliberty' -Dtest=CargoTest,ItineraryTest,RouteSpecificationTest,HandlingEventTest,HandlingHistoryTest,LayeringTest,BookingFacadeDtoTest clean test"
            echo "./mvnw -Popenliberty -Dtest=BookingServiceTest clean test"
            echo 'PACKAGE_LOG="ci-artifacts/build-contract/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)-job-logs.txt"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PACKAGE_LOG")"; ./mvnw -Popenliberty -DskipTests clean package 2>&1 | tee "$PACKAGE_LOG"'
            echo "./scripts/ci/verify-compatibility-contract.sh"
            echo "./scripts/ci/run-observability-check.sh"
            echo "./scripts/ci/run-observability-negative-controls.sh"
            echo "./scripts/ci/run-negative-controls.sh"
            echo "./scripts/ci/run-safety-net-negative-controls.sh"
            echo "./scripts/ci/write-build-metadata.sh"
            echo 'echo "CI_ENDED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"'
            echo "./scripts/ci/write-build-metadata.sh --artifact-metadata"
            echo "./scripts/ci/verify-build-contract.sh"
            echo EOF
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        run: cp -R target/surefire-reports ci-artifacts/test-reports-unit/surefire-reports

steps.name: Assert unit test count
steps.definition:
- name: Assert unit test count
        run: |
          count=$(grep -h '<testsuite ' target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml | sed -E 's/.*tests="([0-9]+)".*/\1/' | awk '{ total += $1 } END { print total + 0 }')
          skipped=$(grep -ho 'skipped="[0-9]*"' target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml | cut -d'"' -f2 | awk '{ total += $1 } END { print total + 0 }')
          test "$count" -eq 27
          test "$skipped" -eq 0

steps.name: Run Open Liberty integration tests
steps.definition:
- name: Run Open Liberty integration tests
        run: ./mvnw -Popenliberty -Dtest=BookingServiceTest clean test
      # clean intentionally removes the unit reports before the separate integration count.

steps.name: Assert Arquillian test count
steps.definition:
- name: Assert Arquillian test count
        run: |
          report=target/surefire-reports/TEST-org.eclipse.cargotracker.application.BookingServiceTest.xml
          test -f "$report"
          count=$(sed -nE 's/.*tests="([0-9]+)".*/\1/p' "$report" | head -n 1)
          failures=$(sed -nE 's/.*failures="([0-9]+)".*/\1/p' "$report" | head -n 1)
          errors=$(sed -nE 's/.*errors="([0-9]+)".*/\1/p' "$report" | head -n 1)
          skipped=$(sed -nE 's/.*skipped="([0-9]+)".*/\1/p' "$report" | head -n 1)
          test "$count" -ge 4
          test "$failures" -eq 0
          test "$errors" -eq 0
          test "$skipped" -eq 0
          for method in \
            testRegisterNew \
            testRouteCandidates \
            testAssignRoute \
            testChangeDestination; do
            grep -Fq "name=\"$method\"" "$report"
          done
